summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for expanding ASCII Fortress with a Smeltery & Forge metallurgy chain, active Goblin raids and Dwarven militia combat, subterranean cavern relics and monsters, Tavern & Temple morale zones, a seasonal Trade Depot barter market, balanced seasonal survival mechanics, and four quality-of-life command upgrades (Tile/Dwarf Inspector, Auto-Queue & Labor Presets, Mini-Map Radar & Z-Level Ore Scanner, and Jump-to-Location Alert Ticker).
